QUOTE: "Callbacks run on the engine thread via `process_events()`, not on the monitor thread." and "Engine-thread callbacks: health events are queued and delivered on the engine thread, so consumer code never runs on the monitor thread."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says health events are queued (with `event_mutex_` guarding the queue) and delivered on the engine thread via `process_events()`, never on the monitor thread.
